$comment: Model routing for mla-pi subagents, all on OpenRouter. Keys are roles: `session` sets pi's own default model (defaultProvider/defaultModel in settings.json); the rest map to the agent mla-pi.mla-<role> via subagents.agentOverrides. Applied by scripts/apply-models.mjs. Every ID must exist in `pi --list-models`; skills fall back to the session model and warn if one is missing.
$policy: Cost-effectiveness is the governing constraint, not open-weight status - a Maryland Legal Aid budget decision. Open-weight is preferred by default, but a closed/proprietary model is allowed where its capability clearly earns the premium (see roles.researcher). Every price below is the provider's full list price, not a promotional rate - re-check before assuming a role is still the cheapest option. See docs/admin.md to change routing org-wide.

session.why: Strongest open-weight generalist available at this price. Drives the /skill:plan interview and interactive work, so reasoning quality and instruction-following matter most here; 1M context holds a full interview plus a large plan in one turn.

scout.why: Cheapest capable model in the catalog. Codebase mapping and tool probing are recall tasks, not reasoning tasks, and its 1M context covers a whole-repo scan.

researcher.why: Closed/proprietary - the one deliberate exception to the open-weight default. Built-in search with citations maps directly onto mla-researcher's one absolute constraint (never state anything you didn't fetch), and research calls are bounded per plan, so the per-token premium stays small in absolute dollars. Also handles PDF input directly, useful for source material MLA staff hand it.

worker.why: Open-weight (MIT). Top rankings on SWE-bench Pro and long-horizon agentic benchmarks (ClawEval, GDPVal), built for exactly the multi-file, many-tool-call shards this role implements. Highest-volume role in the whole lineup, so re-check this price against the catalog before assuming it still pencils out.

reviewer.why: Zhipu/Z.ai - a different lab from worker's Xiaomi/MiMo family, so review is a genuine second opinion, not the same model checking its own work. Never set this to the worker model or its family. Generational upgrade from glm-4.7: benchmarks near frontier proprietary models on long-horizon coding review at a fraction of their cost.
